limitations_and_boundaries: Cell line identity not recently authenticated or Mycoplasma tested.
All experiments used cells with passage number less than 40.
The TAZ-PD-L1 relationship is not conserved in mouse cell lines, limiting translational relevance of mouse models for this pathway.
Other top candidate TAZ-regulated genes from human screen were also not upregulated in mouse cells (e.g., S1pr1, Nlrp3).
PD-L1 may have additional immune evasion roles beyond T-cell function (e.g., macrophage phagocytosis, tumor cell-intrinsic functions) not explored here.
The study focuses on breast and lung cancer cell lines; generalizability to other cancer types is not established.
Coculture experiments used Jurkat T cells, which may not fully recapitulate primary T-cell responses.
Pharmacological inhibition of TAZ/YAP used compounds that may have off-target effects.
